title: Alan Reinstein Ban Asbestos Now Act of 2025
short_title: Alan Reinstein Ban Asbestos Now Act of 2025

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Environment and Public Works.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Environment and Public Works.

summaries.text:
Alan Reinstein Ban Asbestos Now Act of 2025
This bill generally prohibits the manufacture, process, use, and distribution in commerce of commercial asbestos or any mixture or article containing commercial asbestos. The President may, on application, grant exemptions from the prohibition in situations where it is necessary to protect national security interests.
